tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. A pre-dawn indigo, never a tinted black.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Sonogram panels, the camera frame, dark cards.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Tracks and wells: the pace band track, silhouettes, selected nav.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between list rows and the sonogram baseline. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. In dark mode also the 'paper' fill for field-note cards, which flip to ink-on-paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Vireo yellow-green, from the bird's flanks. Speech traces, the on-target pace zone, primary actions, 'keep this' notes.

tokens.name: on-olive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an olive fill.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chip backgrounds for 'keep this'.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Apricot, the nudge colour. Fillers, rushed passages, 'fix next' notes. Always paired with a shape change: flat filler strokes, triangle ticks, a ring on the pace dot.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind filler words in quotes and transcripts.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Teal, for pauses and breath. The pause ring and pause gaps.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The recording dot and destructive actions only. Never used for speaking feedback.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Launch headlines and report verdicts. Scale down with clamp() on small screens.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: Field-guide annotations pinned to the sonogram, and captions.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers in reports and progress.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Vireo listens while you practise and backs every note with the exact words you said.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta, timestamps, helper text. Sentence case, no all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, the sonogram gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections. Generous space is part of the look.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Highlights behind words.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, small panels, quote wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sonogram panels, field-note cards, the camera frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the pace band.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The selected field note and the coach bubble. Used once per screen at most.
